During day 20 and day 23, you have to attend a conference in Riga. You want to spend 5 days in Tallinn. You have to attend a workshop in Tallinn between day 23 and day 27. You plan to stay in Krakow for 5 days. You would like to meet your friends at Krakow between day 11 and day 15 to tour together. You plan to stay in Frankfurt for 4 days.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
